title: Modeling the relative response factor of small molecules in positive electrospray ionization
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37470-37482
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06695B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dimitri Abrahamsson, Lelouda-Athanasia Koronaiou, Trevor Johnson, Junjie Yang, Xiaowen Ji, Dimitra A. Lambropoulou
This study introduces a novel computational method for modeling the ionization efficiency of small molecules in positive electrospray ionization, designed to facilitate the semi-quantification of chemicals in the absence of analytical standards.
